cells.rationale: The latest dated level is 5.051% on 2026-11-19 after four straight daily declines (https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202611198503/10-year-treasury-yield-falls-to-5051-data-talk), with a FRED snippet of 5.10 for 2026-11-17 (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DGS10). The 4.92 line is about 13 bp below that level with roughly six sessions left and no scheduled rate-moving release before the shortened 2026-11-27 session, but nothing after 11-19 was found and the series was 4.84 to 4.90 earlier in November. My earlier thresholds set near the then-current level resolved mixed, so I stay well short of confident.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
